record.original_question: If G is a graph of maximum degree Delta, must its strong edge-chromatic number satisfy chi_s(G) <= 5 Delta^2 / 4 when Delta is even and chi_s(G) <= (5 Delta^2 - 2 Delta + 1) / 4 when Delta is odd? Equivalently, is the Erdos-Nesetril conjecture on strong edge coloring always true?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 26. If G is a graph with maximum degree ∆, then χ_s(G) 6 5∆2/4 if ∆ is even, and (5∆2−2∆+1)/4 if ∆ is odd.
Every graph G with maximum degree ∆ satisfies χ_s(G) 6 1.25∆2. This is the Erd˝os–Neˇsetˇril Conjecture. The best bound for general ∆ is χ_s(G) 6 1.772∆2; see the end of Section 4.1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a simple graph. A strong edge coloring of $G$ is an assignment of colors to the edges of $G$ such that any two edges that either share an endpoint or are joined by an edge receive distinct colors; equivalently, it is a proper coloring of the edges in which every color class is an induced matching of $G$. The strong chromatic index $\chi_s(G)$ is the minimum number of colors in a strong edge coloring of $G$. Let $\Delta(G)$ denote the maximum degree of $G$.

Prove or disprove: For every simple graph $G$ with maximum degree $\Delta=\Delta(G)$,
$$\chi_s(G) \;\le\; \begin{cases} \dfrac{5\Delta^2}{4}, & \text{if } \Delta \text{ is even},\\[4pt] \dfrac{5\Delta^2-2\Delta+1}{4}, & \text{if } \Delta \text{ is odd}. \end{cases}$$
artifact.status_search_result: The Erdős–Nešetřil conjecture on the strong chromatic index remains open in general. It is verified for Δ ≤ 3, and for Δ = 4 the best known bound is 21 colors (Huang–Santana–Yu) versus the conjectured 20. For large Δ, the current best general upper bound is χ_s(G) ≤ 1.772 Δ² (Hurley–de Joannis de Verclos–Kang, 2022), still far from the conjectured 1.25 Δ².

status_evidence.snippet: The Erdős–Nešetřil conjecture states that χ'_s(G) ≤ 5Δ²/4 ... The only nontrivial case verified is Δ = 3.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture stated and noted as open except for Δ ≤ 3.

status_evidence.title: Strong edge-coloring of graphs with maximum edge weight seven
status_evidence.snippet: Hurley, de Joannis de Verclos, and Kang showed χ'_s(G) ≤ 1.772 Δ² for sufficiently large Δ.
status_evidence.claim: Best known general asymptotic bound is 1.772 Δ².

status_evidence.title: On strong edge-coloring of graphs with maximum degree 5
status_evidence.snippet: Progress on small fixed Δ; conjecture not yet established for Δ ≥ 4.
